name: Jotform AI
summary: No-code AI forms and agents with Jotform.
description: Jotform generates forms from a description and offers AI agents that answer visitors and fill forms conversationally by chat, phone or messaging. Responses feed tables and automations.
features: Jotform AI is an AI product for no-code and app builders.
